descriptions.roolz: Roolz is a logistics platform that connects shippers and carriers, enabling cargo matching, bidding, and efficient shipment management. It optimizes costs and time while supporting both spot and long-term partnerships.
descriptions.aibohealth: Aibolit is a platform that helps surgeons manage surgery cases, work with CT files, and generate 3D models. It also enables uploading and editing surgery videos, which can be AI-annotated by phases and events, making it easier to review similar cases and create detailed reports with analytics.
descriptions.getswap: GetSwap is an app for creating item cards, uploading photos, and exchanging items with others. It offers easy browsing, category filters, and built-in chat to arrange swaps.
descriptions.ecw: Education Cannot Wait is a service for remote learning where users register as Teachers or Students. Teachers create groups, assign and track tasks, while students complete and submit them for approval.
